rss: Household energy bills forecast to see biggest rise in four years
title: Energy Costs to Rise
story: Families might have to pay more for electricity and gas soon. This means using less energy at home could help save money.
storyBig: A significant increase in energy costs is expected, which might affect household budgets. Using energy-efficient practices can help mitigate the impact.
think: How can you use less energy at home?
bull: Saves energy, and you get to try cool new energy-saving gadgets!
bear: Higher costs might mean less money for fun activities.

rss: Greggs to shut four factories and cut 740 jobs
title: Bakery Changes: Fewer Factories Open
story: A big bakery company is closing some of its factories. They want to change to meet what customers like more.
storyBig: The company is restructuring by closing some locations to better align with evolving consumer preferences. This could lead to job losses and a shift in production strategies.
think: What could the company do to make customers happy?
bull: New products might be more fun and exciting!
bear: Some people might lose their jobs, which is tough.
